name: task-chime
description: Plays a sound, with optional on-screen signals, when a task is complete.

muted.title: Mute the chime
muted.description: Turn the sound off. With the on-screen signals also off, nothing will tell you a task finished.

volume.title: Chime volume (0-100)
volume.description: Volume of each copy of the chime. Raise it if the chime is too quiet.

copies.title: Loudness boost (1-4)
copies.description: Identical copies of the chime played together. More copies is louder but can distort.

leadMs.title: Bluetooth wake-up delay (ms)
leadMs.description: Silence played before the chime so a sleeping Bluetooth headset can wake. 0 turns it off.

showVisuals.title: Show on-screen signals
showVisuals.description: Show a banner above the prompt, a toast, and a status line entry when a task finishes.
